text:
Bless Yourself with everything you Desire.
Be Your Own God.
author: Respo Amit

text:
Don't Wait For Magic To Happen.
Turn The Page
&
Watch It Live.
author: Respo Amit

text:
As a Final Act,
Do Everything
To Achieve Your Dream.
Become Brutal.
author: Respo Amit

text:
Don't Look For Competition Outside.
Defeat Your Bad Habits.
You'll See The Real Magic.
author: Respo Amit

text:
You Know What Really Matters?
Nothing.
So Relax.
Enjoy The Beautiful Life You've Got.
author: Respo Amit

text:
Don't Beg For Anything,
In front of Anyone
Not Even God.
If You Want It,
Earn It.
Be A Warrior, Not A Beggar.
author: Respo Amit

text:
Success Is Not Easy.
It Is Not For The Weak.
It Comes Through Sacrifice.
Be Strong.
author: Respo Amit

text:
You Can Literally Do Anything In Life.
It's All About Mindset.
Be A Warrior.
author: Respo Amit

text:
To Achieve Anything in Life.
You Just Need Two Things,
Discipline and Consistency.
And You Will Become a Legend.
author: Respo Amit

text:
Bas Ek baar jeetne ke liye na,
bohot baar harna padta hae!
Aur
Jitni baar haar hogi,
Utni hi badi jeet hogi
author: Respo Amit

text:
Agar tum galat bhi ho toh Bhagwan ke alawa kisise darne ki jrurat nahi hae,
Aur agar tum sahi ho toh kisise se darne ki jarurat nahi hae,
fir wo bhagwan he kyu na ho.
author: Respo Amit

text: Haar na man na bhi kisi jeet se kaam nai hae
author: Respo Amit

text:
INNER PEACE
Replace's All the
Broken PIECE
author: Respo Amit

text:
Falling from mountain
can break bones,
But falling for Mountain Heals Everything
author: Respo Amit

text:
You Know What,
You Should Love Yourself more often,
Yeah that's it
author: Respo Amit
